description: This vintage mineral and rock specimen collection contains over 100 individual samples housed in two compartmentalized cardboard trays. Each specimen is labeled with its name and locality, featuring minerals such as manganite, scoria, smoky quartz, serpentine, sphalerite, malachite, obsidian, olivine, marble, pyrite, graphite, galena, garnet, dolomite, and others. The labels indicate origins from various U.S. states, including some cards from the Texas Memorial Museum in Austin, Texas. Specimens are generally small and mounted or glued on individual cards. The collection is in used condition with visible wear, stains, and possible residue from old glue. Total weight is 2.6lbs. Suitable for collectors, educators, or geology enthusiasts.

shipping.policy:

description:
Sheaffer Lifetime Desk Fountain Pen
Vintage Desk Pen and Marble Stand Set
14K Gold Nib, Striped Celluloid, Mid-20th Century
A classic Sheaffer Lifetime desk fountain pen set, representing the pinnacle of mid-century executive office stationery. This set features the renowned Sheaffer's Lifetime 14K yellow gold nib, celebrated for its durability and smooth writing characteristics. The pen is paired with a heavy, rectangular black marble base featuring elegant natural gold-toned mineral veining, creating a sophisticated display piece for a desk or study.
Sheaffer's Lifetime 14K gold nib with hallmark and "Made in U.S.A." engraving
Striped celluloid pen barrel with a long, tapered tail for desk use
Heavy black marble base with gold veining and a swivel brass-tone pen socket
Base measurements: 6 inches (L) x 4 inches (W); Pen length: approximately 6.5 inches
Condition:
14K gold nib appears straight with sharp engravings; internal ink mechanism is untested and may require servicing for functional use. The striped celluloid barrel is intact with no cracks, showing light surface scuffing consistent with age. Metal bands show minor tarnishing. The marble base is in good structural condition with no major chips or cracks. The green felt protective pad on the underside is present but shows partial detachment at one corner.
By bidding on this item, you understand and accept that A) Items are represented to the best of our ability through pictures and description; B) The majority of our items are used and have been donated; therefore, all items are sold as is with no warranties expressed or implied; C) Items are unable to be tested and therefore the working condition is not guaranteed; D) Items have Not been authenticated, certified, or researched unless otherwise stated. Please ask all questions prior to bidding.
Return Policy
ShopGoodwill.com Return Policy: Merchandise is sold As Is. Returns will only be accepted with prior authorization and under the terms stated in this Return Policy. If you have questions regarding the quality or authenticity of this item please contact Goodwill of Central Iowa prior to placing your bid. Items may be returned within five (5) days of receipt if the merchandise was damaged during shipping or if there was a major distortion in the description. Returns will not be accepted without prior authorization. PLEASE NOTE THAT WE DO NOT REFUND SHIPPING AND HANDLING CHARGES. Items selected for pick up from the seller, must be picked up within fifteen (15) days from close of auction. Items not picked up from seller within fifteen (15) days from close of auction will be resold with no further notice

shipping.policy:
Payment:
The only methods of payment we accept are Visa, Master Card, and Discover Card. We do not accept cash, checks, or any other form of payment.
Sales tax will be figured and added to each purchase based on the rate and requirement from your state.
Shipping:
Upon receipt of payment, we utilize Fedex and USPS as our primary shipping carriers. Shipments to P.O. Boxes will be shipped by USPS. We do our best to have items shipped within 7 business days from the date of payment; we are not open on weekends. We are limited to the carriers’ rules and regulations when shipping an order. Shipping charges are calculated at time of payment. Please check shipping rates prior to placing your bid. All items will be shipped as listed and will not be dismantled for any reason.
Minimum shipment weight is 1 lb. Items weighing less than 1 lb. will be calculated at the 1 lb. rate.
Please check shipping rates prior to placing your bid.
Combined Orders:
Multiple items can be combined PRIOR TO the checkout process provided that the payment deadline has not expired on any of the items that you are combining to create the order, and that the combined weight does not exceed 20 pounds. Combined shipping must be requested by the customer prior to payment; it is not automatically allowed. Once an item has been paid for, it is no longer eligible for combined shipping. We reserve the right to deny combination of certain items.
Insurance:
Buyer must email a request for insurance prior to making payment. Insurance cannot be added by the buyer during the payment process. An e-mail must be sent to us and we will then edit the order total for you.
We apologize, but if your package is damaged or lost we will not be able to issue a refund unless your package was insured. We strongly recommend insurance on all breakable items. Photos will be required before a refund will be considered.
Handling Fee:
A minimum of $3.00 handling fee will appear at checkout and applies to all purchases regardless of delivery method or pick up. Our handling fee is a set fee and cannot be adjusted. (Certain items that are very fragile, irregularly shaped, and/or heavy may be subject to an increased handling fee.) These fees, along with your purchase, help to support our Goodwill mission.
